description:
WS5 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. The allowlist/drift guard class (dependency inventory DRIFT, oracle coverage map, parity fixtures, UAT LOC table, release curation list, skill-sync lock, module-size allowlist, DDL governance aliases, CLI-surface allowlist) produces a steady trickle of one-full-CI-round-trip failures, each fixed by a known mechanical action that agents currently rediscover from a hand-carried triage prompt.

Three parts: (1) `make guards-fix` runs every regenerable-artifact fixer (dependency_audit/parse_deps.py, oracle coverage map regen, parity fixtures, uat_loc_table, curation list, skill-sync) then prints git status; (2) remediation-message audit: every drift guard's failure output prints the exact command or ready-to-paste line (DDL check names _DDL_GOVERNANCE_TRANSFORMER_ALIASES; module-size guard prints the allowlist entry with current line count per its re-baseline convention), pinned by asserting the message in each guard's unit test; (3) worktree-claim ensures pre-commit hooks (incl. codespell) are installed in pool worktrees, so spelling never reaches CI.

anti_patterns.dont: Auto-run guards-fix in CI to self-heal drift
anti_patterns.instead: CI fails with the message; the author runs guards-fix locally and commits the diff
anti_patterns.why: Drift signals a decision (a dependency added, a surface changed); silent regen hides it from review

anti_patterns.dont: Free-text the remediation messages without tests
anti_patterns.instead: Assert the remediation text in each guard's unit test
anti_patterns.why: Messages rot as scripts move (the disease this item treats)

preserves.behavior: Each guard still fails CI on drift; guards-fix is remediation, not suppression
guards-fix only regenerates artifacts - it never edits allowlists/ceilings (those stay deliberate human/agent edits with rationale)

verifications.description: guards-fix runs clean on develop and is a no-op

verifications.expected: >= 1 test file asserting guard failure messages

work_units.summary: Inventory regenerable guards + regen commands; wire `make guards-fix`; mention it in the pr skill and failure messages
Remediation-message audit across all drift guards; add message assertions to their unit tests
worktree-claim installs pre-commit hooks in pool worktrees (codespell coverage at commit time)
